title: An Introduction to the Study of the Tarot
author: Paul Case
imprint: Azoth, edited by Michael Whitty, New York, October 1918 to September 1919
short: Introduction to the Study of the Tarot
publicDomain: Published in the US in 1918 and 1919: in the public domain there; Case died 1954.
note: The twelve chapters as first printed in Azoth from October 1918 to September 1919, set from the IAPSOP archive's scans of those numbers. Case issued them as a book in New York in 1920, with a preface; this is the magazine's text, not the book's. Each page was read twice, by Mistral OCR and by Tesseract, and the two were compared word for word with each other and with the scans' own text; every difference was settled on the page image. The printer's spellings are kept as printed, with the italics, the bold leads of chapter III and the Hebrew, which was checked letter by letter against the page.
